title: QMA money-path-relevant candidate field-level diff (AD-14 / CT-47)
description: Named qma-wire schema for a StrategyHandle candidate flagged money_path_relevant. The approval_request payload must carry a field-level diff of exactly the touched risk, sizing, exit, protection, binding, or priority fields against the ancestor. QMA never mints a value where the ancestor carries none (DEC-0313; FR-Q53).
